customer.business: Mitra (beta), a collab marketplace for Bengaluru Instagram creators
customer.target: Bengaluru Instagram creators posting in Kannada and/or English, 2K to 100K followers, who want paid or barter collabs with local businesses and brands
customer.where: Bengaluru (Jayanagar, Basavanagudi, Malleshwaram, Koramangala, HSR, Indiranagar), online on Instagram and WhatsApp

segments.name: Nano creator (2K-10K followers), student or day job, mostly barter so far
Micro creator (10K-50K followers), does a few paid collabs a month
Established local creator (50K-100K followers), collabs are real income, may have a manager

behaviours.name: Barter-first
behaviours.how: Takes free meals and products for posts; rarely asks for money.

behaviours.name: Rate-card professional
behaviours.how: Has a rate card, sends a media kit, invoices brands.

behaviours.name: Burned before
behaviours.how: Was ghosted on payment or paid a 'registration fee' to a fake agency; distrusts platforms.

behaviours.name: Already on an app
behaviours.how: Has Influish or a similar app; applies to campaigns and waits.

behaviours.name: Growth-hungry
behaviours.how: Cares more about followers and reach than money right now.

behaviours.name: Kannada-first
behaviours.how: Makes Kannada content; feels national brands ignore regional creators.

behaviours.name: Free-only
behaviours.how: Never pays for creator tools; uses whatever is free.

objections: Will there actually be businesses on it, or is it empty like other apps?
Why pay ₹499 a year when barter deals come to my DMs anyway?
Influish costs the same and already has lakhs of creators
Giving an app access to my Instagram feels risky
Auto-DM might get my account flagged by Instagram
Local cafés pay in food, not money
Is this run by a real company? Who do I complain to if a business doesn't pay?
habits: you post 3 to 4 reels a week, mostly food and places in South Bengaluru
you get 2 or 3 collab DMs a week, half of them sketchy
you are in 4 creator WhatsApp groups that share collab leads
you check your Instagram insights every morning
you work a day job and edit reels at night

pitch:
Mitra (beta): find collabs that fit you, in one place. Bengaluru, Kannada and English.
A café you've worked with sends you a Mitra link: "Join with my link and let's do our collabs through Mitra."
Connect your Instagram (read-only). Mitra fills in your profile and shows every local business and brand that fits you. Your first collab is free. After that, the Creator Pass is ₹499 a year for more collabs and Auto-DM (a comment like DOSA gets an automatic DM with the café's coupon).
Mitra tells you up front: the business that sent you the link gets ₹150 from Mitra when you buy the pass. As a pass holder you also make short promotional videos for participating businesses.
Mitra never takes a cut of your collab fees. Beta: a small team, Bengaluru only.
